verdict.rationale: Semgrep Secrets' own docs say detected secrets are tested against a web service to confirm they grant access, labeled as valid (actively in use), and prioritized for security engineers. Valid secrets are also surfaced in PR/MR comments. Missing for 10: documentation of which issuing services or providers are covered, details on how validation runs or is configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration that validation works.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can have detected secrets verified against the issuing service so I know which ones are live

citations.quote: valid secrets are those that have been tested against a web service and confirmed to successfully grant resources or authentication. They are actively in use.
Semgrep saves security engineers time and effort by prioritizing valid leaked secrets
informs developers of valid secrets in their PRs and MRs by posting comments directly
